notes: Assembled 2026-11-05 from en.cppreference.com page text via browser.open (C reference only; no C++ pages). Subset: the C reference index, the C language index, the standard library headers index, the 9 core C language topic pages (basic concepts, keywords, preprocessor, statements, expressions, initialization, declarations, functions, history of C), and one page per C standard library header (all 32 headers listed on the headers index, including the draft C29 <stdmchar.h>). Each page is a function/type/macro inventory with one-line descriptions plus the page synopsis (full declarations); this is the header-level reference, not the per-function documentation. NOT included: the ~hundreds of individual function/type/macro pages (e.g. c/string/strlen, c/io/fprintf), the per-topic sub-pages under each language topic (e.g. translation phases, operator precedence, value categories), compiler-support pages, technical-specification pages, and the symbol index. No 429/rate-limit was encountered; all 44 fetches succeeded. Caveats: (1) page-text extraction occasionally drops table/list content - e.g. the <inttypes.h> PRI/SCN format-macro tables and some keyword-list rows were not captured and this is noted in the text file; the <math.h> synopsis on the site itself is only a '// TODO: ...' placeholder and is recorded as such; the <stdlib.h> header table lists only the program-termination functions and its synopsis contains a stray call_once declaration, both preserved as fetched; the <string.h> synopsis spells two typedefs 'tyepdef', a typo on the site page, preserved as fetched. (2) Cleaning was minimal: navigation/menu/footer and link markup stripped, 3+ blank lines collapsed (verified: no run of 4+ newlines remains), multi-line declarations in the <stdmchar.h>, <wchar.h> and <tgmath.h> synopses reflowed onto single lines / name lists with no declarations removed (noted in the text file at each such section). (3) Licence is CC BY-SA 3.0 + GFDL, not CC BY-SA 4.0; share-alike applies to modified versions and the FAQ asks for a link back to cppreference.com. (4) Content reflects the site as crawled 2026-11-05 (C23 as current standard, C29/C2y drafts in progress).
